facts.statement: Each player received one free item per day for seven days when logging in; logging in before the last day allowed collecting all seven.
facts.quote: Un objet par jour pendant sept jours vous sera donné quand vous vous connectez.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A French-language SOE welcome-back news post for returning players, dated only as 'Posted 2 weeks, 3 days ago' (so roughly May 2011, not exact). It announces free game time for accounts active before 2 May 2011, a seven-day login gift series of free items, and extra gifts for lifetime members. Item names are given in French and are only loosely matched to client strings.
